title: Bridge
descriptionTransfer: Your transfer, from departure to arrival.

route.robinhoodUsdc: USDC on Robinhood is unavailable: its routes do not pass our current safety checks. ETH remains available.

form.approvalConfirmed: USDC approval confirmed. Review a fresh quote before bridging. No funds have been bridged yet.
form.disclaimer: Keep some {symbol} on {network} for gas. {converts, select, yes {Relay converts the asset at the quoted rate. } other {}}Bridging uses Relay, a third-party protocol, and carries risk. Openlaunch does not operate Relay, holds no funds in transit, and is not responsible for delays, refunds or losses. {approval, select, yes {An unspent USDC approval remains until used or revoked.} other {No token approvals required.}}

quote.expiredNotice: This quote expired. Refresh and review the new amounts.
quote.slippage: 0.5% slippage limit. Arrival time and gas can change.
quote.approveFirst: First, approve only {amount} USDC for Relay’s deposit contract. Then review a fresh quote and confirm the bridge separately. Approval alone does not move your funds and uses additional {symbol} for gas.
quote.enterAmount: Enter an amount. We’ll find your route.
quote.preview: See your route before you commit.
quote.keepTyping: Keep typing. We’ll use your latest amount.
quote.automatic: Quotes update automatically. No wallet request until you confirm.

feeLimit.label: Quote above safety limit
feeLimit.whyFee: Relay’s fee is {percent}% of your amount. Openlaunch blocks quotes above 5%. Source gas is extra and is not included in this limit.
feeLimit.whyLoss: This quote loses {percent}% in conversion and fees. Openlaunch blocks quotes above 5%. Source gas is extra and is not included in this limit.
feeLimit.hint: Change the amount or route. Your quote updates automatically.

approval.verifyingDetail: Checking the transaction on {network}. No wallet request will be made.
approval.walletDetail: Approve the exact USDC amount in your wallet. This is not the bridge deposit.
approval.uncertainDetail: The wallet response was interrupted. Check your wallet’s activity and verify the transaction hash below. Do not approve again.
approval.waitingDetail: Waiting for {network} to confirm. You’ll review a fresh bridge quote next.
approval.notice: No bridge deposit has been requested. An approval permits Relay’s deposit contract to use up to this amount; it does not bridge it.
approval.spedUp: Sped up your approval in the wallet?
approval.recoverHelp: Copy the confirmed approval hash from your wallet’s activity on {network}. We’ll verify the network, wallet, token, spender, exact amount and confirmation before resuming. A cancellation or an unrelated transaction cannot be used.
approval.discardHelp: No confirmation was found for this saved approval hash. This does not prove the transaction was dropped. Check your wallet’s earliest pending transaction before starting over; discarding this record does not cancel it or fix a queued nonce. If it confirms later it only grants this exact allowance; the next deposit re-checks it.
approval.resume: You can close this panel. Reopen Bridge with this wallet to resume. If you stop after approval, the unspent allowance remains until used or revoked.

transfer.onItsWay: Your transfer is on its way
transfer.arrivedDetail: Relay has confirmed {symbol} delivery to your receiving wallet.
transfer.refundDetail: Check your wallets on both networks and Relay’s transfer details before trying again.
transfer.revertedDetail: The source network rejected the deposit. Your {symbol} was not bridged; network gas was still charged.
transfer.failedDetail: Relay couldn’t complete this transfer. Check the transfer details for recovery before sending again.
transfer.uncertainDetail: The wallet response was interrupted. Don’t send again while we check whether your deposit was submitted.
transfer.walletDetail: Review the network, amount and transaction in your wallet. Nothing moves without your confirmation.
transfer.pendingDetail: You can close this panel. Reopen Bridge with this wallet to check its status.
transfer.delayed: Taking longer than expected. Tracking continues.
transfer.liveStatus: Live status from the bridge provider
transfer.delivered: Delivered to the same wallet address
transfer.discardHelp: Relay has not seen a deposit for this transfer and nothing is confirmed on {network}. If your wallet shows the transaction as dropped or cancelled, you can discard this record and start over. Keep the Transfer ID below in case you need Relay support.

waiting.title: Approval submitted
waiting.detail: Waiting for a confirmation. You’ll review a fresh bridge quote next.

not-seen.title: Approval not found by the network
not-seen.detail: This network node cannot find the saved transaction. It may still be queued in your wallet, dropped, or replaced. Check your wallet’s activity; do not approve again just because it is missing here.

queued.title: Waiting for an earlier transaction
queued.detail: This approval uses nonce {nonce}, but your wallet’s next confirmed nonce is {latestNonce}. Check the earliest pending transaction in your wallet on this network. Later transactions cannot confirm first.

nonce-passed.title: Check your wallet’s transaction history
nonce-passed.detail: This nonce has already been used, but the saved approval has no receipt. It may have been replaced, or the node may be catching up. If you sped it up, verify the confirmed replacement hash below.

fee-too-low.title: Approval fee is below the network fee
fee-too-low.detail: The submitted transaction’s fee cap is below the current base fee. Review its fee in your wallet. If you choose to speed it up, return with the confirmed replacement hash; do not create a second approval.

delayed.title: Approval is taking longer than expected
delayed.detail: The network can see the transaction, but it has not confirmed. Check its status and fee in your wallet. If you sped it up, verify the confirmed replacement hash below.

unavailable.title: Approval status unavailable
unavailable.detail: The network could not provide transaction details. Checking will retry. Check your wallet’s activity before taking any action; do not approve again.
